locator.section: web/www/missa/Latin/Sancti/02-02.txt [Graduale], Alleluia-only lines 177–178; preceding gradual excluded

entries.claim: The exact pinned direct Latin Mass body at lines 177–178 corroborates the complete 10-word Alleluia and verse as a derived digital witness. The digital Graduale section prints it after the Gradual, which is excluded here; no inherited reference or expansion supplies this body.

The complete 10-word Alleluia and verse has been checked directly on the Benziger Brothers 1962 Editio iuxta typicam page, printed p. 467, leaf n548. After Septuagesima it is omitted and the Tract is said instead. This states current conformity, not original transcription genesis.
